description: This file defines an in-memory, thread-safe repository implementation for managing notes, including create, read, update, and delete operations with an initial seed note.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory repository for notes implementing CRUD operations.

methods.name: InMemoryNotesRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a sample note.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new note, assigning a new Guid if necessary, and sets creation and update timestamps.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a note by its Guid identifier.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its Guid identifier, if it exists.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing note and refreshes its 'UpdatedAt' timestamp.
